evals.name: archive-meal-template
evals.prompt: Add an endpoint to archive a meal template. Route: POST /nutrition/meal-templates/{TemplateId}/archive. Sets ArchivedAt on the MealTemplate document (the field does not exist yet — add it). Only the trainer or nutritionist who owns the template may archive it. Returns 200 with the template's id and archive time. Returns 404 if the template does not exist or is not owned by the caller, 409 if it is already archived.
evals.expected_output: Files under Features/MealTemplates/ArchiveMealTemplate/: request with a PascalCase TemplateId matching the route, endpoint gated with Roles(AppRoles.Trainer, AppRoles.Nutritionist), Summary with a Responses entry for 200/400/401/404/409, a plain-class response with a FromDocument factory exposing ExternalId, Send.UnauthorizedAsync guard on the UserId claim, Send.NotFoundAsync for missing or not-owned, this.SendProblemAsync(409, ErrorCodes.X, ...) for already archived, TimeProvider for ArchivedAt, Send.OkAsync(response, ct) on success. No FeatureConfiguration, WithTag, Policies or Send.ErrorsAsync. Tests handed to dotnet-tdd with a 404 not-owned test and no per-endpoint 401/403 test.

evals.name: client-measurement-overview
evals.prompt: Add GET /client/measurements/overview/{Year}. Returns the calling client's body measurements grouped by month for the given year. Response shape: { Year, Months: [{ Month, Count, AverageWeightKg }] }. Only the client role may call it.
evals.expected_output: EF read with AsNoTracking and a Select projection filtered on the caller's user id, Roles(AppRoles.Client), validator inheriting Validator<T> with a year range rule, response as a plain class (not a record) exposing no long Id. Tests: validator TestValidate for the range, one 400 endpoint test, one 200 integration test using TestActors that asserts the grouped values filtered to the test's own data.

evals.name: client-milestone-entity
evals.prompt: Scaffold a new feature letting a trainer or nutritionist record a milestone for one of their linked clients: POST /trainer/clients/{ClientId}/milestones with Title (required, max 200) and AchievedOn (date). There is no storage for it yet — create the EF entity too. Returns 201 with the milestone's public id.
evals.expected_output: New entity in Domain/Entities inheriting PublicTimestampableEntity (no redeclared Id), DbSet registered, migration handed to dotnet-migrate and not applied. AchievedOn is DateOnly. Endpoint checks the caller's live link via IClientLinkAuthorizationService.GetCapabilitiesByClientPublicIdAsync (not only the role) and returns 404 when there is none. Response exposes PublicId. Send.CreatedAtAsync tested through FitnessApiFactory. Includes a 403/404 test for the missing link.

evals.name: announcements-interview
evals.prompt: Add announcements. An admin creates them with title, text and expiration. A GET endpoint returns those that have not expired yet.
evals.expected_output: Asks only what it cannot infer (who may read announcements, route prefix, storage: EF or Mongo) before scaffolding. Then two actions in their own folders (e.g. CreateAnnouncement, GetActiveAnnouncements) with domain-prefixed, globally unique endpoint names, Roles(AppRoles.Admin) on create, TimeProvider for the expiry comparison, and no empty request DTO (EndpointWithoutRequest for the list if it takes no input).
